answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit before it can trade, slashed when peers prove misbehavior. Like light through a prism, one identity splits into verifiable facets — work history, stake, and peer attestations — so a flood of fake copies cannot all pass the same checks. Honest agents that build reputation earn cheaper access, turning the marketplace into a haven for proven actors rather than a free meadow for throwaway sock puppets. Creating a credible identity costs real time and stake, so thousands of fakes stop being profitable.
